card.name: The word River in river names
card.fires_on: The word "River" right after a proper place name, as in Connecticut River or Mystic River. It appears in geography and encyclopedia-style text.

modes.label: Name plus River
modes.description: "River" follows a named river, such as a place or person name.

modes.label: River before name
modes.description: "River" comes after "the" and before the river's name.
modes.example: it became necessary to tap the<< River>> Lee nearby.

card.plain: It lights up on the word River when it is part of a named river, like Connecticut River.
